panels.description: Lina removes a membrane cartridge from a House test rig. Keep the upper rig clear.
Suri shields a living root filter from a disposal chute. Keep the upper chute clear.
Jalen watches surveillance reflected in his collar mirror and hands Alex a data shard. Keep the upper reflection clear.
Ren opens a scorched fabrication case in a House work area. Keep the upper case clear.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: They want my name on an unsafe claim. I’m not signing it.

items.speaker: SURI
items.text: It fails if the flow is wrong. I’m taking it.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: If the small shop can’t service it, it isn’t a product.
